text: The customer needs help pairing their Lumo Hub with the app, as the device is stuck with a blinking orange light. So far, the customer has tried a 10-second reset, used a different phone, and verified they are on a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network, but none of these steps worked. The case is being escalated to the technical team for a callback by Friday, and the customer noted they need the hub working before the weekend.
